thresholds.rule: Maximize mean video detection BA across validation ref/Q80/Q40
thresholds.ties: Closest to 0.5, then smaller threshold; tolerance 1e-12

analysis.seed_variation_note: Mean and sample SD across three seeds are descriptive; they are not confidence intervals.
analysis.qualification: Conditional on selected checkpoints and thresholds; excludes selection uncertainty and training-seed variability

fft.probability_mapping: Softmax of ridge scores; calibration unverified
fft.shuffle_rule: Permute five-way labels across training videos
fft.qualification: Diagnostic controls; validation tuning is optimistic

compression.probe_selection: Existing reference-selected alpha and fitted heads retained
compression.threshold_rule: Maximize mean video detection BA over validation ref/Q80/Q40

compression.qualification: Threshold-tuned validation scores are optimistic. Additional JPEG compression of C23-derived crops. PSNR compares decoded RGB crops; JPEG bytes are crop sizes, not video bitrate.
compression.resource_qualification: Timer starts after loading and reference smoke check. GPU figures use the PyTorch allocator; system RAM is unmeasured.

analysis.qualification: Descriptive validation intervals conditional on selected ridge penalties and thresholds; excludes selection uncertainty. Intervals are unadjusted across the representation panel.

jpeg_q40.scaling: Training-compressed-feature mean and population standard deviation
jpeg_q40.alpha_selection: Mean validation detection/source BA at threshold 0.5
jpeg_q40.threshold_rule: Maximize video detection BA on matched-quality validation
jpeg_q40.threshold_ties: Closest to 0.5, then smaller threshold; tolerance 1e-12
jpeg_q40.scope_note: Planned E02 known-quality control, prepared after exploratory reference-probe validation and before test scoring.
jpeg_q40.qualification: Validation-selected results are optimistic. Matched-quality adaptation is distinct from reference-trained compression retention. Original and adapted probes use different threshold selection domains; AUROC and fake-only attribution do not depend on the detection threshold. Five shuffles are diagnostics, not a formal significance test.
jpeg_q40.resource_qualification: Timer includes backbone loading, extraction, fitting and per-probe writes after input audits. GPU figures use the PyTorch allocator; system RAM is unmeasured.

definition.complete_video: Video with all eight scheduled reference crops valid in reference.csv
definition.complete_group: Provenance group whose ten core videos are all complete_video
definition.thresholds: Frozen full-cohort validation thresholds; no reselection on subsets
definition.models: All nine RGB runs, six reference-trained probes, twelve known-quality probes
definition.bootstrap: Provenance-group resampling over the full validation groups; subset metrics use drawn indices within each support, preserving multiplicity
definition.flags: Contrast status change = sign change or change in whether the 95% interval excludes zero
definition.test_application: Apply the identical support rules and frozen thresholds to test predictions; reselection is not permitted

complete_eight_frame_sensitivity.qualification: Validation-only sensitivity of selected models and frozen thresholds; intervals exclude selection uncertainty and seed variability. Subsets are nested in the full cohort, so differences are not independent comparisons.

comparison_register.qualification: Freezes the register text and the validation records it cites. Controls C1-C3 are registered but not yet trained; their checkpoints, heads and thresholds enter through the G3 model-freeze amendment.

c1_c2_rgb_runs.rule: Maximize mean video detection BA across validation ref/Q80/Q40 (detection-trained controls only)
c1_c2_rgb_runs.ties: Closest to 0.5, then smaller threshold; tolerance 1e-12
c1_c2_rgb_runs.untrained_heads: C1-DET and C2-BIN source outputs and C1-ATT detection outputs are not interpreted

c2_source_readout.control: C2 readout R (frozen-encoder ridge source probe)
c2_source_readout.features: 512-d pooled ResNet-18 encoder output; eval mode; float32; batch 8 as in training-time prediction
c2_source_readout.deviation_note: First attempt (batch 64) stopped at the native-prediction check (max difference 0.0014 from TF32 convolution algorithm choice); no outputs were kept. Rerun at batch 8.
c2_source_readout.training_views: Fake training crops at ref, Q80 and Q40 (Pillow 4:2:0), pooled
c2_source_readout.scaling: Mean and population SD of the pooled training features
c2_source_readout.alpha_selection: Mean validation fake-only attribution BA over ref/Q80/Q40; smaller alpha on ties
c2_source_readout.p_fake: Native detection head of the same encoder (unchanged)
c2_source_readout.qualification: Validation-selected and optimistic. A linear readout measures linearly accessible source information, not all information in the encoder.

c3a_border_probes.procedure: F4: training-only scaling; alpha by reference-validation mean det/src BA at 0.5; threshold maximizes mean video detection BA over validation ref/Q80/Q40
c3a_border_probes.qualification: Validation-selected and optimistic. Manipulation traces can extend beyond the detector box, so border performance is a caveat, not proof of a shortcut.

c3b_metadata_probe.qualification: Validation-selected and optimistic. Predictable metadata indicates a dataset-level cue that crop models could only use indirectly; it is a caveat, not proof of use.

c3c_content_decomposition.retention_rule: Unclipped chance-adjusted BA retention; undefined when reference is < chance + 0.05
c3c_content_decomposition.qualification: Descriptive. Family separation can reflect identity change rather than method-specific traces; within-family BA isolates finer method cues.

dinov2_extraction.normalization: ImageNet RGB normalization; probe scaling uses training only
dinov2_extraction.qualification: Frozen backbone; common 224x224 study crops; no additional geometry. Timer includes decoding and cache writes, excludes model loading. No test predictions or classifier fitting.

qualification: Contains aggregate metrics and provenance, not raw predictions, images, feature arrays or model parameters. Bootstrap intervals condition on selected models and thresholds. Seed SD is descriptive. Source LF hashes account for repository text normalization.
